name: Nightbound
source:
Your life as a cashier is a loop of monotony. Alone and restless, you seek change. Then a peculiar stranger, intrigued by you, appears outside work. Do you take the risk of getting closer?

[From [url=https://frengoestudios.itch.io/nightbound]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
收银员的生活是单调的循环。孤独而焦躁的你寻求改变。然后，一个对你感兴趣的奇怪的陌生人出现在工作之外。你愿意冒险靠近吗？

[来自[url=https://frengoestudios.itch.io/nightbound]Itch.io[/url]]
